I built this as a two-column layout. The left column has a header and a flip deck of ten vocabulary cards. The right column has a "Cards reviewed" progress bar and a short study tip. The catalog has no single-column container, so I used the two-column layout to place the progress bar next to the deck.

The progress bar starts at 0 of 10. The catalog has no event wiring that would update it as cards are flipped, so it will not advance on its own. Your application would need to update it.
